The counsel for the petitioners stated that the present FIR is the outcome of the matrimonial dispute between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 and the allegations pertaining to the offence under section 376 IPC were made against the petitioner no. 5 who happens to be the brother-in-law (Nandoi) of the respondent no. 2.
The respondent no. 2 has made these allegations only to implicate the family members of the petitioner no. 1, which are stated to be false and fabricated.

In these circumstances, the counsel for the petitioners prayed for quashing of FIR bearing no. 0397/2021 along with consequential proceedings as the disputes between the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have already been settled and their marriage has already been dissolved as per Islamic Law.
